# Policy history + rollback

<!-- Generated by `go run docs/roadmap/gen.go docs` from tickets.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Phase:** [P1 · Who did it](../README.md#phase-1--who-did-it) · **Lane:** Control plane · **Label:** `feature:policy-versioning` · **Epic:** [#41](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/41) · **Tickets:** 4 (1S 3M)

Policy and distributed settings move from in-place edits of the served YAML into a versioned store in CP state. Every save creates a new immutable version with author and message, admins can diff any two versions and roll back in one click, and workers are always served the current version. Existing deployments migrate automatically on first start.

## How we build it

- cpstate table `policy_versions(version INTEGER PK, created_at, author_sub, author_email, message, parent_version, doc_json, doc_sha256)`, where doc_json is the policyWire body {allowlist, denylist, settings}, and a `policy_head(version)` pointer. Versions are append-only.
- Rollback to version N creates version M = latest+1 with N's doc and message `rollback to N`. History is never rewritten. `blockedUsers` lives outside versions, so a rollback can never unblock a user.
- `policyServer.loadPolicy` reads the head version from the store instead of the YAML file. The ETag stays the sha256 prefix of the marshaled wire, so long-poll and the worker `behind` flag work unchanged.
- `WritePolicy`/`WriteSettings` (ConfigEditor) create a version and require `If-Match: <head version>`, returning 409 on a stale head. CP-local blocks (integrations, detection, console) stay in the served YAML and keep today's YAML round-trip editor.
- Migration: if the store is empty at start, import the current served config's policy+settings as version 1 (author `import`). After that, external edits of `policy:`/settings blocks in the YAML are ignored with a warning, and `warden policy import --state-dir <dir> --file <yaml> --message` creates a version from a file.
- Diff: structural, not textual. Allow/deny entries are keyed by domain+port+groups (added/removed/changed), and settings by JSON path.

## Done when

An editor saves three policy changes, sees three versions with author and diffs, rolls back to version 1, and workers pull the rolled-back policy within one long-poll cycle, with each step recorded in the admin audit log.

### 1/4 · W-P1-PVER-01

**Add versioned policy store and serve the head version**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#42](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/42)

Add the `policy_versions` and `policy_head` migrations and a `PolicyVersionStore` (Create(doc, author, msg, expectedHead), Head(), Get(v), List(cursor)) in internal/controlplane. Change `policyServer` to load the head from the store when `Config.State` is set, keeping the YAML path for stateless CPs, and call `Refresh()` after Create so long-poll waiters wake immediately. Validate a doc with the existing config validator before it becomes a version.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] /policy returns the head doc, and its ETag changes only when the doc content changes
- [ ] Create with a stale expectedHead returns ErrConflict and writes nothing
- [ ] An invalid doc (bad regex domain) is rejected and the head is unchanged

**Depends on:** [`W-P1-SSO-01`](console-sso-rbac.md#16--w-p1-sso-01) Add internal/cpstate SQLite state store with migrations

**Unblocks:** [`W-P1-PVER-02`](policy-versioning.md#24--w-p1-pver-02) Migrate file-edit-in-place to versioned writes

### 2/4 · W-P1-PVER-02

**Migrate file-edit-in-place to versioned writes**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#43](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/43)

On CP start with an empty store, import the served YAML's policy + `SettingsWireFromPolicy` as version 1. Change `Server.WritePolicy`/`WriteSettings` to build the new doc from the head and create a version, with the author taken from the request Principal. This needs the dashboard writer setters to pass `context.Context` (`SetPolicyWriter(func(ctx, config.Policy) error)`). Stop the 3s YAML re-read from changing policy/settings, and log a warning when the file's policy block differs from head. Add `warden policy import`.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] An upgrade test: a CP started on an existing state dir serves byte-identical /policy JSON before and after migration
- [ ] A dashboard save records the session user's sub/email as the author
- [ ] `warden policy import` creates a version and wakes connected workers

**Depends on:** [`W-P1-PVER-01`](policy-versioning.md#14--w-p1-pver-01) Add versioned policy store and serve the head version; [`W-P1-SSO-05`](console-sso-rbac.md#56--w-p1-sso-05) Map groups to roles and enforce role checks on dashboard APIs

**Unblocks:** [`W-P1-PVER-03`](policy-versioning.md#34--w-p1-pver-03) Add policy history, structural diff and rollback APIs

### 3/4 · W-P1-PVER-03

**Add policy history, structural diff and rollback APIs**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#44](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/44)

Add `GET /dashboard/api/policy/versions`, `GET /dashboard/api/policy/versions/{v}`, `GET /dashboard/api/policy/versions/{v}/diff?against={u}` and `POST /dashboard/api/policy/versions/{v}/rollback` (editor). Put the diff in a new `internal/controlplane/policydiff.go`. Allow/deny entries are keyed by domain+port+groups+users, and settings are compared by JSON path with {added, removed, changed}. Rollback creates a new version, and the admin audit target is `policy` with before/after head hashes.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Diff unit tests cover entry add/remove/change and a nested settings change
- [ ] Rollback produces head = latest+1 with doc_sha256 equal to the target version
- [ ] A viewer can list and diff but gets 403 on rollback

**Depends on:** [`W-P1-PVER-02`](policy-versioning.md#24--w-p1-pver-02) Migrate file-edit-in-place to versioned writes; [`W-P1-AAUD-02`](admin-audit-log.md#23--w-p1-aaud-02) Record every CP mutation via audit middleware with state hashers

**Unblocks:** [`W-P1-PVER-04`](policy-versioning.md#44--w-p1-pver-04) Add history panel with diff view and rollback to dashboard

### 4/4 · W-P1-PVER-04

**Add history panel with diff view and rollback to dashboard**

Type **feature** · Size **S** · Issue [#45](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/45)

In `internal/dashboard/index.html`, add a History panel to the policy tab. It lists versions (version, author, time, message), shows a side-by-side diff against head, and has a rollback button with a confirm dialog. The save dialog asks for an optional message and sends `If-Match`. On 409 the UI reloads head and shows 'policy changed by <author>'.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] A dashboard test checks that the history endpoint wiring renders and that rollback calls the API with the CSRF header
- [ ] A concurrent edit returns 409 and shows the conflicting author

**Depends on:** [`W-P1-PVER-03`](policy-versioning.md#34--w-p1-pver-03) Add policy history, structural diff and rollback APIs
